preservedResponsibilities: Body/cell text, live cursor/range factories, insert/append portions, paragraph finishing, content attachment and TextToTable delegation.

SwXCell is defined after SwXText and reexported from unotbl.ts so ES module evaluation preserves the original base class before subclass initialization. Table conversion follows original table/cell property denylists and per-property UNO exception isolation; row properties apply only to existing rows.
omittedResponsibilities: Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim.
